attempts.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT symbol_id FROM code.symbols WHERE file_id = 'auto_ontology/retrieval/text_to_sql/base.py' AND name = 'BaseAgent' AND kind = 'class'), agents AS (SELECT s.symbol_id, s.file_id FROM code.symbols s JOIN code.class_bases b ON b.class_symbol_id = s.symbol_id JOIN base ON b.base_symbol_id = base.symbol_id JOIN code.files f ON f.file_id = s.file_id WHERE s.kind = 'class' AND f.is_test = FALSE), constructed AS (SELECT c.callee_symbol_id AS symbol_id, f.is_test FROM code.calls c JOIN code.files f ON f.file_id = c.caller_symbol_id WHERE c.call_kind = 'direct' AND c.callee_symbol_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT DISTINCT a.symbol_id AS class_symbol_id FROM agents a WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM constructed c WHERE c.symbol_id = a.symbol_id AND c.is_test = FALSE) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM constructed c WHERE c.symbol_id = a.symbol_id AND c.is_test = TRUE) ORDER BY class_symbol_id

request:
Consider the agent classes defined in non-test code that directly subclass BaseAgent from auto_ontology/retrieval/text_to_sql/base.py (every file under a tests/ folder, conftest.py and helpers included, is test code). Which of these agent classes are constructed (the class is called by name, e.g. ResponseAgent()) somewhere in non-test code but are never constructed anywhere in test code? Count only direct constructor calls written in a function or method body; patching or referencing a class without calling it does not count, and a test that calls a function which constructs the class does not count as constructing it. Return their class symbol IDs.

Requested output columns: class_symbol_id (string).
explanation: Finds BaseAgent in base.py, then all non-test classes that directly subclass it. It checks direct call edges where the callee is the class itself, keeping classes constructed in non-test code but never constructed in test code.
sql: WITH base AS (SELECT symbol_id FROM code.symbols WHERE file_id = 'auto_ontology/retrieval/text_to_sql/base.py' AND name = 'BaseAgent' AND kind = 'class'), agents AS (SELECT s.symbol_id, s.file_id FROM code.symbols s JOIN code.class_bases b ON b.class_symbol_id = s.symbol_id JOIN base ON b.base_symbol_id = base.symbol_id JOIN code.files f ON f.file_id = s.file_id WHERE s.kind = 'class' AND f.is_test = FALSE), constructed AS (SELECT c.callee_symbol_id AS symbol_id, f.is_test FROM code.calls c JOIN code.files f ON f.file_id = c.caller_symbol_id WHERE c.call_kind = 'direct' AND c.callee_symbol_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT DISTINCT a.symbol_id AS class_symbol_id FROM agents a WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM constructed c WHERE c.symbol_id = a.symbol_id AND c.is_test = FALSE) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM constructed c WHERE c.symbol_id = a.symbol_id AND c.is_test = TRUE) ORDER BY class_symbol_id
